public_git_tag.reproducibility: Consumers should pin an explicit version, tag, or commit for repeatable installs.

version_ref_semantics.installed_version: package.json version of the installed Bandit package
version_ref_semantics.current_source_ref: npm version, Git tag, Git commit, or tarball identifier the consumer installed
version_ref_semantics.comparison: An update is available when the release manifest latest_version or latest_ref differs from the installed version/ref.

update_source.description: Repo-local, checked-in, or operator-accessible release manifest read from .bandit/update-channel.json update_source.path. No hosted service is required.

manifest_fields.reader_behavior: readFileReleaseManifest requires latest_version and latest_ref, uses update_command when present, and ignores optional metadata fields that are not needed for deterministic update-check output.

update_check.normal_cli_alert: Normal CLI commands emit a concise non-blocking stderr alert only from a fresh cached update_available result and never mask the requested command's stdout, stderr, or exit status.

data_minimization.rule: Update metadata is repo-local, reviewable, and data-minimal.

non_canonical_authority: Update metadata, cached update results, package registries, and consumer install state are advisory only; repo-native .bandit/ state and CLI commands remain authoritative.
